entries.title: What this project is
entries.summary: ## What this project is "Zillow for distressed and government-sold property" — a discovery/triage layer over sheriff sales, trustee sales, HUD/REO, IRS/Treasury/GSA dispositions. Three layers: static PWA (v0, `index.html`/`app.js`), Node `http` listing API (v1, `server/`), Next.
